## Scope

The 2023 Q1 grading quality audit examined 492 second reads taken during the quarter. Its purpose was to review the consistency between the first and second grades recorded for each set. The audit considered the completed second reads within the quarter and compared them with the corresponding first grades. This provided an overall view of agreement for the audit period.

The review was limited to the reads included in the audit material. Individual results are not set out in this summary.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 60.8 per cent of sets reviewed. This is the overall agreement result for 2023 Q1.

Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately, supporting appropriate review of individual performance and any follow-up required. The summary result should therefore be read alongside the detailed spreadsheet information.
